 Learn more As the third quarter earnings season winds down, the strength of corporate results has been undeniable. 
 And there are still handfuls of companies that are reporting this week, from quantum computing companies D-Wave Quantum ( QBTS ) and Rigetti Computing ( RGTI ) to AI neocloud companies like CoreWeave ( CRWV ) to consumer facing companies like On Holdings ( ONON ). 
 According to FactSet data , approximately 88% of S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) companies have already reported Q3 earnings, with an overall earnings growth rate of 31.4%. If that rate holds, it will mark the third straight quarter of earnings growth above 25% for the index. 
 Follow along for live updates on this week's corporate results. 
 LIVE 1 update Mon, November 9, 2026 at 10:05 PM UTC Grace O'Donnell Take-Two Interactive stock pops as CEO says 'Grand Theft Auto VI' preorders hit 'unprecedented levels'
 Take-Two Interactive ( TTWO ) stock jumped in extended trading as anticipation for next week's launch of "Grand Theft Auto VI" overshadowed mixed second quarter results. 
 "Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 are tracking far in excess of our initial expectations. And we know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough," CEO Strauss Zelnick said on the earnings call. 
 Zelnick also noted that as preorders for GTA VI reach "unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company." 
 In the fiscal second quarter, Take-Two posted a loss of $0.29 per share on revenue of $1.5 billion. Wall Street analysts were looking for an $0.86 loss per share on $1.65 billion in revenue, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence. 
 The company reiterated its full-year outlook for net bookings of $8 billion to $8.2 billion. Revenue is expected at $7.98 billion to $8.18 billion.
